description: Cultural Accessibility from GTFS Wikidata and OSM is a model or code deposit deposited in Zenodo by its authors Javier Sanchis, Sandra García-Ponsoda (Lucentia Research Group). This repository contains the reproducible software workflow developed for the paper Gravity-Based Cultural Accessibility Assessment from GTFS, Wikidata and Pedestrian Networks: A Cross-City Study. The software integrates GTFS public transport schedules, Wikidata semantic cultural Points of Interest, and OpenStreetMap pedestrian-network data to compute bus-based gravity accessibility indicators for cultural destinations. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is MIT. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
